name: IG Port,Inc.
summary: IG Port, Inc. and its subsidiaries are an animation production company operating in Japan, the United States, the rest of Asia, Europe and elsewhere. Its segments are Video Production, Publishing, Copyright, Product Sales and Other, covering animation and game software for theaters, television and video, licensing, and the publishing of comic books, illustration collections and e-books. Dating from 1987, it has its headquarters in Musashino, Japan.
